description_en: Queries the information about a RAM user
description_zh: 查询指定的RAM用户的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ims get-user --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --user-id 207329002493920000 --user-access-key-id LTAI0000000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetUser

parameters.help_en:
The logon name of the RAM user.

The name is in the format of `<username>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`. `<username>` indicates the name of the RAM user. `<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com` indicates the default domain name.

The value of `UserPrincipalName` must be `1 to 128` characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The value of `<username>` must be `1 to 64` characters in length.

You must specify only one of the following parameters: `UserPrincipalName`, `UserId`, and `UserAccessKeyId`
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的登录名称。

格式为`<username>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`，其中`<username>`为RAM用户名称，`<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`为默认域名。 

`UserPrincipalName`长度为`1~128`个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。其中`<username>`的长度为`1~64`个字符。

必须指定 `UserPrincipalName`、`UserId`和`UserAccessKeyId`三个参数中的一个参数，但不能同时指定
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the RAM user.

You must specify only one of the following parameters: `UserPrincipalName`, `UserId`, and `UserAccessKeyId`
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户ID。
必须指定 `UserPrincipalName`、`UserId`和`UserAccessKeyId`三个参数中的一个参数，但不能同时指定
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The AccessKey ID of the RAM user.

You must specify only one of the following parameters: `UserPrincipalName`, `UserId`, and `UserAccessKeyId`
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的访问密钥ID。
必须指定 `UserPrincipalName`、`UserId`和`UserAccessKeyId`三个参数中的一个参数，但不能同时指定
parameters.name: user_access_key_id

User.description_en: The information about the RAM user

Comments.example: This is a cloud computing engineer.

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the RAM user was created
CreateDate.description_zh:
RAM用户的创建时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-12T09:12:00Z

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the RAM user

Email.description_en:
The email address of the RAM user.

This parameter is valid only on the China site (aliyun.com)
Email.description_zh:
RAM用户的电子邮箱。
该参数仅适用于中国站

LastLoginDate.description_en: The last time when the RAM user logged on to the Alibaba Cloud Management Console
LastLoginDate.description_zh:
RAM用户最近一次登录控制台的时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-12T09:12:00Z

MobilePhone.description_en:
The mobile phone number of the RAM user.

This parameter is valid only on the China site (aliyun.com)
MobilePhone.description_zh:
RAM用户的手机号码。
该参数仅适用于中国站

ProvisionType.description_en:
The source of the RAM user. Valid value:

Manual: The RAM user is manually created in the RAM console.

SCIM: The RAM user is mapped by using System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM).

CloudSSO: The RAM user is mapped from a CloudSSO user
ProvisionType.description_zh:
同步类型。取值：
Manual：在RAM中手动创建的RAM用户。
SCIM：通过SCIM协议同步创建的RAM用户。
CloudSSO：通过云SSO同步创建的用户

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the information about the RAM user was updated
UpdateDate.description_zh:
RAM用户的更新时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-13T07:39:22Z

UserId.description_en: The ID of the RAM user

UserName.description_en: The username of the RAM user, which is the prefix of the logon name of the RAM user
UserName.description_zh: RAM用户的名称，即登录名的前缀

UserPrincipalName.description_en: The logon name of the RAM user
